$comment: Real captured Error.stack strings, one per engine. Frames on the wire are crash-LAST and columns are 0-BASED; every engine gives the opposite of both, so these are the two things an SDK gets backwards. `frames` below is already in wire order, so the LAST entry is the crash site.
$note: Columns here are the wire values (already decremented). A stack with no column information omits `col` entirely rather than inventing a 0, which would be indistinguishable from a real first-column frame.
